name: customapis-demo
description: Public demo environment for customapis.co — read it, don't run it.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const f=require('./package.json').dependencies.pgrm.replace(/^file:/,'');if(!require('fs').existsSync(f))console.error('
  This repository is not runnable from a clean clone.
'+'  It depends on pgrm — the framework underneath — which is not published,
'+'  so the install below will fail on '+f+'.

'+'  That is expected. Read the source instead, and call the live API at
'+'  https://timesheetdemo.customapis.co — see README.md.
')"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run replay
scripts.db:reset: docker exec -i customapis_demo_db psql -U demo -d customapis_demo -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:schema: docker exec -i customapis_demo_db psql -U demo -d customapis_demo
